documents.unit: Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning (Provost)
documents.title: Assignments, AI Tool and Policies (syllabus builder)
documents.summary: A syllabus-builder help page from the Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning. It makes an AI Tool Usage statement a required syllabus section and leaves the content (allowed, limited or prohibited) to each instructor, with sample language in a help panel.
documents.stance_why: The page sets no university rule on AI itself: "Instructors must select or enter a statement explaining how generative AI tools may be used, limited, or prohibited in the course", so the decision is handed to each instructor, with only a required-statement duty.

units.why: The page says the AI Tool Usage section "must be completed before submission", an obligation on instructors to state AI expectations in every syllabus, so P09 (not P04, which is about who decides the rule).
units.anchor: private and must be completed before submission.

units.policy: The AI Tool Usage section of the syllabus is required and private and must be completed before submission.

units.why: Instructors must choose a statement on how AI "may be used, limited, or prohibited", so the rule is set per course by the instructor and the page takes no stance itself: P04. The duty to write a statement is the separate P09 unit.
units.anchor: Instructors must select or enter a statement explaining how generative AI tools may
units.policy: Instructors must select or enter a statement explaining how generative AI tools may be used, limited, or prohibited in the course.

units.why: The sentence "Clear AI guidance helps set expectations for academic integrity and responsible use" gives a reason for stating AI rules, grounded in integrity, so informs; P95 is nearest, though it also speaks of responsible use and clear expectations.
units.anchor: Clear AI guidance helps set expectations for academic integrity and responsible use
units.fit_note: Also says clear guidance supports responsible use and clear expectations, which P95 (fairness and honesty) does not capture.

units.why: "Examples and optional language for both sections are provided in the Help Text panel" means the institution supplies sample syllabus language for instructors to adopt, so P110.
units.anchor: Examples and optional language for both sections are provided in the Help Text panel.

notes: Single thin document; rest of page (recording policy, ADA, mutual respect) is not about AI and was skipped.
